_meta.description: The 4 boss-slot catalog entries whose vanilla chr is _source=script_spawn (c4670 Ancestor Spirit, c4690 Grafted Scion). All 4 are members of V3_SPAWN_POOL_MSBS — i.e., they're already in the rando's runtime-pull infrastructure for rotation bosses, but they take a different code path than the other 19 spawn-pool MSBs because their chrs are target-only.

architecture.static_placement: Each of these 4 MSBs has a pi=1 entry holding the rotation chr at origin sentinel (0, 0, 0). The MSB itself is small (3 Parts typically) — it serves as a 'source template' for the SmallBaseAttached runtime system to copy chrs into live arena MSBs.
architecture.runtime_attachment: When the player enters the corresponding live arena (e.g., the castle interior where m46_91 attaches), vanilla EMEVD invokes SmallBaseAttached to ferry pi=1 of the spawn-pool MSB to the arena's attach point. The chr at that point gets spawned into the live world.
architecture.rando_pipeline_handling: include_spawn_pool_msbs() (dcx_batch.py) ensures all V3_SPAWN_POOL_MSBS are pulled from spawn_pool_source_dir if not in the user's input. Confirmed via pipeline_metadata.spawn_pool_in_input — all 23 members present in seed 271328. The shuffler then iterates over them, but the script_spawn_target_only_at_msb filter in oops_v3.py:~9963 SKIPS these 4 (vs. swap-them like the other 19). pi=1 stays vanilla; n_swaps=0 in spoiler's spawn_pool_results.

_meta.user_visible_bug: Seed 271328 (v0.24.33, MP-safe OFF): Alaric reported castle basement boss missing — no health bar, no guy. Pipeline metadata shows m46_91 spawn-pool ran with n_swaps=0 (correctly preserved vanilla). The vanilla EMEVD should have ferried c4690 to the castle arena. Missing-boss symptom suggests the EMEVD chain itself broke. Could be: (a) entity_id mismatch elsewhere broke the ferry trigger, (b) chrbnd preload set for the live arena map doesn't include c4690 in some run, (c) a different rando modification incidentally broke the spawn.
_meta.future_work: Two paths: (a) implement the 'Fix path NOT YET IMPLEMENTED' described at oops_v3.py:6182-6200 (bypass the near-origin/target-only filter for V3_SPAWN_POOL_MSBS pi=1 entries, let the rando pick a non-script_spawn target chr); (b) trace the EMEVD chain to identify why it breaks for the rotation chr at m46_91. Path (a) is more ambitious but addresses the broader picker-control question; path (b) addresses the specific bug. Either way, playtest validation required.
